The cross-coupled NMOS pair is asymmetric: M3 is W=0.42 µm while its partner M4 is W=0.994 µm. Every other matched pair in the netlist is equal (M1/M2, M5/M6, M7/M8, M9/M10, Mi1/Mi3, Mi2/Mi4), so M3 is the outlier. A 2.4× imbalance in the regeneration pair gives the latch a built-in offset far larger than the ±2 mV input, which explains the wrong decisions. It also slows regeneration on that side, which fits the large delay violation. Energy is unaffected, consistent with its passing result.
